angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 340,197 km at 117.48 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.5120 +/- 0.0163 mas (same row, RUWE 1.06): 117.48 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.489 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Kanodia et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-6034 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract): 340,197 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.514 +/- 0.025 solar masses from Kanodia et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-6034 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3635 +/- 88 K from Kanodia et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6034 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Kanodia et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-6034 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-6034.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.770, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-6034: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6034 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.09 dex, from Kanodia et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6034 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.4034, from Kanodia et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6034 (pscomppars): age 7.8 Gyr, from Kanodia et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-6034 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Kanodia et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168..235K/abstract)
